theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) blended with Apple-like Cinematic Minimalism
theme_and_archetype.description: A premium, Apple-like marketing site. Cinematic full-bleed visuals, smooth scrolling (Lenis), and highly polished typography. Combines a youthful energy for teens with the trust and reliability needed for task posters. The aesthetic relies heavily on the requested color palette: Olive Green, Black, and Dusky Sand.

typography.strategy: The 'Editorial Future' pairing. Distinctive, modern, and cinematic. Avoid generic sans like Inter.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold

rules: Headings strictly use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Never center-align large paragraphs of text.
Use massive typographic contrast between headings and body text.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Apple-like breathing room.
rules: Use sections with alternating backgrounds (Dusky Sand to True Black) for cinematic contrast.
Images must often break the grid or be full-bleed.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-8 or p-12).

glassmorphism.nav: backdrop-blur-xl bg-dusky_sand_light/80 border-b border-black/5 dark:bg-black/60 dark:border-white/10

cards.style: Flat solid surfaces. Subtle 1px borders (border-black/10). No muddy drop shadows. Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for a modern premium feel.

buttons.primary: bg-[#4B5320] text-[#F2EFE9] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold hover:bg-[#3A4019] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-[#F2EFE9] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold hover:bg-black/80 transition-colors duration-300
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#0A0A0A] text-[#0A0A0A] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold hover:bg-[#0A0A0A] hover:text-[#F2EFE9] transition-all duration-300

motion_and_interactions.scroll: MANDATORY: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling. This is critical for the Apple-like feel.

animations.fade_up: Use Framer Motion to fade up and slightly translate-y text elements as they enter the viewport.
animations.parallax: Apply subtle parallax effects to full-bleed hero images and background elements.
animations.hover: Scale images slightly (1.05) on hover within bento grid cards.

images.description: Teenager using phone outdoors. Hero section.
Stylish modern teenager holding a smartphone showing a notification. Good for 'How it Works' or 'For Teens'.
Person in a field with a dog. Good for gig categories (dog walking).
Young woman using phone with building in background.
Woman holding cell phone and cash. Good for earnings/trust section.

component_instructions.navigation: Sticky crystal glass nav. Logo on left, links in center, 'Join Waitlist' CTA on right.
component_instructions.hero: Full-bleed cinematic layout. Massive typography (Cabinet Grotesk). Headline: 'Small Tasks. Instant Cash.' Subhead: 'The app where teens earn real money for everyday gigs. Safe, local, and fast.' Waitlist email input + App Store badges.
component_instructions.how_it_works: Scroll-triggered 3-step timeline. 1. Browse gigs. 2. Accept task. 3. Get paid instantly. Use Framer Motion for step reveals.
component_instructions.features_bento: Asymmetric bento grid. Showcase gig categories (Lawn mowing, Dog walking, Tech help). Use rounded-3xl cards with Dusky Sand backgrounds and Olive Green accents.
component_instructions.trust_and_safety: Black background section. High contrast. Typography in Dusky Sand. Emphasize parental consent, verified users, secure payments.
component_instructions.waitlist_form: Simple, high-converting input field + submit button. Store in DB (mocked for frontend if no backend provided, but must be structured as a functional form).
component_instructions.footer: Massive typography for 'QuickBuck'. Minimal links. Social icons. Dark background.

testing.data_testid: MANDATORY: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) must have data-testid attributes.
